translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: 1 Korint
book.title: 1 Korint Nalob̃ulat napisulan na-vǝha-sual-an aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Korint

content: Nǝlahan
Ale gagai nuke nisor husur nasoruan samit gail len nalob̃ulat napisulan mǝttotosi van hǝn ginau. Mǝtuke, “Ivoi hǝn naulum̃an ideh hǝn asike b̃ibar niben napǝhaṽut.”
Avil bathut nǝvanuan isob̃ur lotogol naitian tosa, nukel mai gamit ke, naulum̃an tolah tikad naitian mai asoan sǝb̃on, ale napǝhaṽut tolah tikad naitian mai asoan sǝb̃on.
Asoan aulum̃an b̃elǝŋon naitian, aulum̃an tigole maii. Asoan apǝhaṽut b̃elǝŋon naitian, apǝhaṽut tidam̃ hǝni maii.
Niben apǝhaṽut savi esan sǝb̃on ŋai, be evi sisoan. Ale len naṽide tomaienan, niben aulum̃an savi esan sǝb̃on ŋai, be evi sisoan.

Samretǝgau gat nibemǝr sǝb̃omǝru dan gamǝr gabag. Be mǝrb̃ike mǝrb̃isor tuṽ husur nǝmariboŋ galevis, ale mǝrb̃idam̃ mai gamǝr gabag, inor hǝn mǝrb̃etǝgau gat nibemǝr sǝb̃omǝru dan gamǝr gabag. Nǝboŋ nǝmariboŋ galenan lǝb̃inoŋ, mirib̃on tǝtas. Asike mǝrb̃igole, dereh aSetan tidas p̃isal hǝn b̃eliv gamǝru hǝn mǝrb̃iteh husur mǝrsǝdaŋ.
Nǝsakel nakelean todaŋ ke mirimastǝgau gat nibemǝr sǝb̃omǝru dan gamǝr gabag m̃os na-sor-tuṽ-an; ao nudam̃ hǝn b̃imaienan ŋai.

Beti nolǝŋon ke nǝvanuan p̃isi lǝtasum̃an ginau. Be len nakitinan, gidat p̃isi datukad naviolan aGot toviol hǝn ṽisusua mai gidato. Nǝvanuan sua ikad naviolan tomaiegai, nǝvanuan sual am ikad naviolan tomaienan.
Ale nukel mai alalum̃an asoalit lotomat mai nǝbatunau pǝhaṽut gail ke, asike lǝb̃ilah be lǝb̃itoh maienan ŋai, sum̃an ginau, ivoi.
Be asike lǝb̃etǝgau gat nǝlolito dan naitian tosa, lilah. Husur savoi hǝn lǝb̃elǝŋon masuṽ hǝn naitian; ivoi sǝhori am ke lilah.
Nukad nakelean todaŋ m̃os nǝvanuan nadǝlomian lotolah. Savi nakelean sagw be evi siYesu. Imaiegai ke: napǝhaṽut sateriŋ asoan.
Be alitenan b̃eriŋ asoan, satilah mai naulum̃an ideh am. Alitenan titoh maienan ŋai o tigol nǝsasaan tokade mai asoan tinoŋ ale tib̃on tǝlmam maii. Ale naulum̃an sateriŋ asoan.

Ale nukad nakelean m̃os nǝvanuan gail am. Evi ginau notokele, savi Nasub̃. Nekǝmaiegai ke: naulum̃an ideh siYesu b̃ikad asoan sǝkad nadǝlomian, ale alitenan b̃ehǝhaṽur hǝn b̃itoh maii, aulum̃an satetiṽos hǝni.
Ale napǝhaṽut ideh siYesu b̃ikad asoan sǝkad nadǝlomian, ale atenan b̃ehǝhaṽur hǝn b̃itoh maii, apǝhaṽut satetiṽos hǝni.

Husur nǝlahan apǝhaṽut siYesu tokade mai asoan inor len nǝhon aGot bathut nadǝlomian selitenan. Ale nǝlahan aulum̃an siYesu tokade mai asoan inor len nǝhon aGot bathut nadǝlomian sitenan. Asike tǝmagenan, natǝtai samit gail lǝtatoh len nǝbathudud tob̃iŋb̃iŋal len nǝhon aGot. Be gagai lutoh len nǝbathudud tonor len nǝhon.

Be gai sǝkad nadǝlomian b̃elǝŋon natiṽosan, tehusur nalǝŋonian san. Nǝboŋ tomaienan, nǝlahan enan sǝbaŋis gat asoan tokad nadǝlomian. Be b̃elǝboi b̃igole, nǝvanuan tokad nadǝlomian tetǝgau gat nǝlahan sǝlaru bathut aGot ekis gidato m̃os natǝm̃at.
Latpǝhaṽut mǝttovi siYesu, len gamito hum ma asoamit lǝb̃eriŋ nǝlolit len aYesu. Ale lalum̃an mǝttovi siYesu, len gamito hum ma asoamit lǝb̃eriŋ nǝlolit len aYesu.

Be gamit ṽisusua, asoam̃ b̃imat o asoam̃ b̃ikad nadǝlomian o asoam̃ asike b̃ikade, len natohan ideh gototoh lan nǝboŋ aGot tokis gaiug, gitoh maienan lan. Nukel nakelean enan todaŋ mai alat siYesu len naut p̃isi.
Avan ideh b̃ikad na-tiv-dalusi-an nǝboŋ aGot tokisi, satesusuan nabuŋon hum sǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an. Ale asike b̃ikad na-tiv-dalusi-an nǝboŋ aGot tokisi, satikade.
Datb̃ikad na-tiv-dalusi-an o datb̃ipar tiv-dalusi-an savi natideh. Be datb̃igol husur nakelean todaŋ aGot tokele, enan nab̃iltitite!
Len natideh avan ideh totoh lan nǝboŋ aGot tokisi, titoh maienan lan.
Govi slev nǝboŋ aGot tokis gaiug a? B̃imagenan, sa-nǝlom̃ tetuhatuh hǝni. Avil gǝb̃elǝboi gǝb̃ikad nǝmakuvan hǝn asike gǝb̃evi slev am, gigole.
Husur nǝvanuan tovi slev nǝboŋ aGot tokisi, savi slev am be evi siNasub̃. Len naṽide tomaienan, nǝvanuan savi slev nǝboŋ aGot tokisi, evi slev seKristo.
Nǝsa aGot toṽur gamit hǝni, etibau masuṽ. Samtehusur nǝvanuan gail sum̃an mǝttovi slev salito. Mǝtehusur Nasub̃.
Bathudud nadǝlomian, len natideh mǝttotoh lan nǝboŋ aGot tokis gamito, mititoh mai aGot lan.
Alat lǝsǝlah
Ale gagai nuke nisor var nausian samit husur navensus gail. Nǝsǝkad na-kel-buni-an ideh siNasub̃, be nukel nǝ-nau-sǝhoti-an sagw, bathut len nalolosaan san, Nasub̃ igol notodaŋ len gai.
Imaienan, bathut nǝmauran todaŋ mǝttotoh lan, nunau maiegai ke: ivoi hǝn naulum̃an b̃itoh hum totoh gagai.
Gǝb̃ilah mai napǝhaṽut tia, sagidas p̃isal hǝn gǝb̃imakuv dan nǝlahan samǝru. Asike gǝb̃ilah, sagidas pǝhaṽut hǝn gǝb̃ilah maii.
Be gǝb̃ilah, savi nǝsaan; ale navensus b̃ilah, savi nǝsaan. Be alat lotolah dereh lisab̃ nǝmauran egai tidaŋ len nǝboŋ gail, ale nomǝtahun mǝtb̃elǝŋon b̃isa maienan.
Bathudud nadǝlomian, nekǝmaiegai ke: namityal em̃idol. Gagai van, naulum̃an tokad asoan, nǝlahan sǝlaru satiwol hǝn nǝmauran san.
Nǝvanuan totaŋ, nǝtaŋan san satiwol hǝn nǝmauran san. Nǝvanuan tohǝhaṽur, nahǝhaṽuran san satiwol hǝn nǝmauran san. Nǝvanuan top̃urp̃ur tite, natit gail gai topul hǝni saliwol hǝn nǝmauran san.
Ale nǝvanuan toumum mai natit gail hǝn navile a pan, navile a pan satiwol hǝn nǝmauran san. Husur navile eg a pan hum topat gagai, satovan vǝmasig.
Nolǝŋon ke mitimakuv dan natit gail len nǝmauran egai nǝlomit totuhatuh hǝni. Naulum̃an sǝlah elǝboi b̃inau masuṽ hǝn Nasub̃ mai naṽide b̃igol Nasub̃ b̃ehǝhaṽur lan.
Be naulum̃an tolah inau masuṽ hǝn navile a pan mai naṽide b̃igol asoan b̃ehǝhaṽur.

Ale sǝdaŋ kavkav len gǝlar p̃isi, Nasub̃ mai asoan. Napǝhaṽut sǝlah, navensus, inau masuṽ hǝn Nasub̃ hǝn gai b̃evi siNasub̃ sǝb̃on len niben mai nanunun. Be napǝhaṽut tolah inau masuṽ hǝn navile a pan mai naṽide b̃igol asoan b̃ehǝhaṽur.

Nokǝmaienan m̃os nǝb̃evi tarhǝt samito, savi hǝn nǝb̃iwol hǝn nǝmauran samito. Nokǝmaienan hǝn naṽide samit b̃inor, hǝn mǝtb̃igol tabtab hǝn nǝsa Nasub̃ tolǝŋoni, hǝn asike natideh b̃eliv nǝnauan samit dani.
Be naulum̃an ideh b̃inau ke sagol sanor hǝn navensus tokel gati ke b̃ilah maii, ale nǝlon atenan b̃esursuru hǝni (hum b̃imasmagenan), tilah maii hum tolǝŋoni. Savi nǝsaan.
Be naulum̃an b̃eil gǝgat len nǝsa tonau, ale natideh asike b̃etǝgau gati, be nǝsa b̃igole b̃ipat len gai sǝb̃on, ale b̃inau sǝhoti len nǝlon ke asike ilah mai navensus, enan tu ivoi.
Imagenan, naulum̃an tolah mai navensus san igol natit tovoi, ale naulum̃an sǝlah maii igol natit tovoi am sǝhori.

Napǝhaṽut tolah, nǝlahan tokade mai asoan ipat vǝbar asoan b̃imat. Be asoan aliten b̃imat, imakuv dan nǝlahan enan, ale elǝboi b̃ilah mai avan ideh b̃elǝŋoni. Be natsua, naulum̃an b̃ilah maii timasvi siYesu.
Len nabunusian sagw, napǝhaṽut asoan tomat b̃itoh sǝb̃on maienan ŋai, dereh tehǝhaṽur am. Ale nunau ke aNunun aGot evi tarhǝt sagw hǝn notokǝmaienan!

footnotes.text: 7.36 Len naut a Korint alat siYesu galevis lunau ke lotolo, ale nǝlahan mai nǝmauran hǝn nǝlahan arsavi natideh. Imagenan, hum ma lotosor len naulum̃an egaii toke tilah, gol ke atenan inau ke sagol sanor hǝn navensus b̃ike b̃ilah maii. Ale evǝlo. Nǝboŋ naves egai toke nǝlon atenan esursuru hǝn navensus, nasoruan ta Kris ikad namilen tile am toke navensus egǝm vi bareab. Be naut kǝmas namilen toru enan, aPol ike inor hǝn arb̃ilah.
7.38 Len naut egai aPol ike, naulum̃an tolah mai navensus san igol ivoi ale husur nǝmauran egai idaŋ len nǝboŋ gail (geris 7.26), naulum̃an sǝlah mai navensus san igol ivoi am sǝhori.
